content:
alex: quick heads up — noticed pilot glidepath auto-fallback telemetry isn't surfacing prefix/KV cache hits or sampled payloads. makes it hard to tell whether regressions are model-quality vs infra. proposing lightweight event tags + 1% sampled payloads from pilot sessions.

maria: +1. that was exactly what blocked root-cause yesterday. question: do we tag per-request or per-session? per-request gives finer signal but huge cardinality.

kevin: per-session tag + per-request sampled traces seems sane. session tag = "pilot=true" so we can roll up, and sample 1% requests with full trace and payload hash.

chris: we also need the rollout decision boundary to be pluggable. router should be able to fallback based on latency p95 + quality probe signal. how do folks want to version that policy?

alex: thinking: policy as a small JSON DSL (versioned). router reads policy_version from placement config. rollout controller can push policy changes via canary route. fallback rules = ordered list of predicates + actions. example snippet: 
```
{
  "version": "v1",
  "rules": [
    { "pred": "latency.p95 > 400ms", "action": "soft_fallback", "scale": 0.5 },
    { "pred": "quality.delta < -0.03", "action": "hard_fallback" }
  ]
}
```

sue: careful about session affinity / KV-cache pinning. if we abruptly move users to baseline variant they'll miss warm cache state. need graceful drain semantics.

maria: agreed — add a "drain" state where router redirects new sessions away but lets existing KV-affined sessions finish, with a TTL. ops should be able to force-evict after X minutes.

kevin: operationally we need an independent probe service that generates deterministic queries (from eval set) and reports quality/latency. it must be independent of production tokens to avoid noise and throttling effects.

alex: +1. also add an emergency circuit override: if SLO breach > threshold we auto-evacuate pilot traffic to baseline. keep two knobs: soft_fallback (gradual, %-based) and hard_fallback (immediate).

chris: for quality signals we can't rely solely on user feedback or mirroring. recommend canary-synths + live-graders (lightweight heuristics) to estimate hallucination/accuracy within minutes.

maria: metrics to track during rollouts: latency p50/p95, error-rate, quality-score delta, sampled embed cosine drift, sample payload failure modes. include model variant id, quantization label, and policy_version in all telemetry.

kevin: also capture routing reason metadata (why a request was sent to fallback) so we can surface common predicates firing.

deploy-bot: deploy: rollout-policy-v2 pushed to staging at 1790123600 :rocket:

sue: action items captured: alex draft RFC with policy DSL + telemetry schema; kevin design probe svc; chris design routing API + policy reader; maria define ops runbook (drain/evict flows). sync Thu 10am.

alex: I'll put a stub RFC up by EOD Tues and ping the channel. thanks all.
